name: myanimetracker
description: Anime watch orders, filler guides and this week's episodes from MyAnimeTracker, plus your own list when you sign in.

interface.longDescription:
MyAnimeTracker keeps whole anime series in release order. Ask what order to watch a franchise in, which episodes of a long series are filler, or what is airing this week, with no account needed. Sign in with your myanimetracker.com account and it can also read your list, add a series to it (all its seasons and films count as one), and mark episodes watched. It only adds; it never removes or overwrites anything on your list.

Answers carry structure only: order, episode counts, dates and episode numbers, never plot summaries or images, so nothing it returns spoils a story. It covers safe-for-work titles only. Catalog data comes from the anime offline database (ODbL) and Wikidata (CC BY-SA), credited in each result.
defaultPrompt: What order do I watch Monogatari in?
Which Naruto Shippuden episodes are filler?
What anime comes out this week?

positive.prompt: What order do I watch Monogatari in?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Monogatari seasons and films in release order with episode counts and dates, no plot summaries, and the source credits.

positive.prompt: Which Naruto Shippuden episodes are filler?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the filler episode numbers and ranges for Naruto Shippuden, with the source credits.

positive.prompt: What anime comes out this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists safe-for-work titles with episodes airing this week, with their episode numbers and dates.

positive.description: Add a series to the signed-in person's list
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in, adds Frieren as one series (its seasons together) to the reviewer account's list and says what changed. Nothing already on the list is overwritten.

positive.description: Mark episodes watched on the signed-in person's list
positive.prompt: Mark episodes 1 to 12 of Dandadan as watched.
positive.expected_behavior: After sign-in, marks Dandadan episodes 1 through 12 watched on the reviewer account and confirms it. It never unmarks an episode.

negative.description: Plot summaries are out of scope
negative.prompt: Summarize what happens in Attack on Titan season 4.

negative.description: Removing from the list is not supported
negative.prompt: Delete everything on my MyAnimeTracker list.

review.commerce_description: No tool sells anything or links to a purchase.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, watch order, filler guide, this week's episodes, and signed-in list tools.
